worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement between $t=0$ and $t=1.$ Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{0}^{1}(\frac{1}{1+{t}^{2}})\,\text{dt} \\  & =(\operatorname{arctan}⁡(t)){|}_{0}^{1} \\  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(1)-\operatorname{arctan}⁡(0) \\  & =\frac{\pi }{4}-0 \\  & =\frac{\pi }{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
